svg.text: Datacern on Google Cloud — Deployment Architecture
As provisioned by the shipped IaC: deploy/terraform/gcp (VPC · GKE · Cloud SQL · Managed Kafka · Memorystore · GCS · Artifact Registry · KMS · Secret Manager) + Helm umbrella chart (values-gcp.yaml)
VPC network — private subnets, Cloud Router + Cloud NAT for egress
network.tf · iam.tf (Workload Identity service accounts) · secretmanager.tf / secrets_backend.tf (External Secrets sync into the cluster)
gke.tf — private cluster, node pools · Workload Identity · images from Artifact Registry
Ingress — GCLB → bff-graphql + ui-web (global static IP reserved in terraform)
Helm umbrella chart, one Deployment per service,
• AI plane: agent-runtime, ai-gateway, memory, eval, tool-plane
• Data plane: ingestion, dataset, semantic, query, chart
• Governance: case, rbac, audit, notification, realtime-hub
Argo Workflows server: infra-gated add-on — orchestrator ships
the submit/watch client; server install is a deploy-time choice
tainted so only training Jobs schedule here;
training without touching the services pool
pipeline runs are lease-held; a pod lost to scale-in or
preemption stops heartbeating and the orphan reaper
recovers the run on another instance — no stranded
migration 0004 · every instance sweeps, claim is one conditional UPDATE
Cloud Logging/Monitoring · Prometheus rules + Grafana dashboards + ServiceMonitors (chart templates) · Tempo tracing
Artifact Registry (artifactregistry.tf) — CI pushes images tagged by commit SHA; Helm pins global.imageTag at deploy
External Secrets Operator syncs Google Secret Manager → k8s secrets (templates/externalsecret.yaml + secrets_backend.tf)
KMS key ring (kms in network/iam tf) encrypts state at rest · Workload Identity replaces long-lived keys

g.text: Cloud SQL — PostgreSQL 16
system of record for all services · FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY per tenant · non-superuser app roles enforced at boot
cloudsql.tf
Managed Service for Apache Kafka
event backbone (google_managed_kafka_cluster) · transactional outbox relay — nothing publishes before its DB commit
kafka.tf
Memorystore — Redis
consumer dedup, semantic-cache index, rate limits, sandbox-reaper leader election
memorystore.tf
Google Cloud Storage
datasets (parquet), model artifacts, scoring outputs, audit archive — uniform access, CMEK-encrypted
Iceberg lakehouse tables live here behind the in-cluster REST catalog + Trino
gcs.tf
Cloud KMS + Secret Manager
at-rest encryption keys · runtime secrets synced into the cluster via External Secrets · IAM-scoped per service account
secretmanager.tf
Pub/Sub topic (aux eventing)
provisioned alongside Kafka for cloud-native notification fan-out where configured
kafka.tf
LLM providers — brokered by ai-gateway, never called directly by agents
Anthropic API and/or Vertex AI (Claude on Vertex), configured per tenant · semantic cache, token budgets and
cost metering sit in front of every call · prompts leave the VPC only to the configured provider
Trust boundary notes
• Tenant isolation is enforced in Postgres (FORCE RLS) — not in application code an attacker could skip
• Audit chain hashes are verifiable off-platform; archive bucket is CMEK-encrypted and IAM-scoped
• Agent writes require a four-eyes approval that mints an RS256-signed execution grant — cloud IAM
compromise alone cannot make an agent's proposal execute

svg.text: dev / CI: docker-compose parity stack (same open-source images) — the tier where the 3,029-test evidence run executed.

cloud: this page — terraform apply (deploy/terraform/gcp) then helm upgrade -f values-gcp.yaml. Sibling stacks shipped for AWS, Azure and Hetzner — portability comes from every stateful dependency being open-source.

Honesty note: the AWS/GCP/Azure paths are the shipped, reviewed IaC — they are infra-gated and have not been exercised from the evaluation sandbox (no cloud credentials there). The executed-verification tier to date is local/CI.
Source: deploy/terraform/gcp/*.tf, deploy/helm/datacern (values-gcp.yaml), deploy/k8s/data-tier at commit 54cfe2d · generated 2026-07-30
